Because the caller profiles are shared with other folders, the change does not alter what tests outside Insurance use.
The answer lists exactly the 10 evaluators 201003, 201009, 201015, 201021, 201027, 201033, 201039, 201045, 201051, 201057, found by reading every page of the folder.
